cli_build: fill a template with the charts of a deck specification
cli_check: check a presentation against a corporate design file
cli_deck: presentation whose data links are updated
cli_description: Build a presentation from a template and a deck specification, or update its links.
cli_design: corporate design file (colour scheme JSON with check rules)
cli_fix: fix every deviation and save the presentation
cli_locale: language of messages, e.g. de or en-GB (default: LibreOffice's UI locale)
cli_no_libreoffice: LibreOffice was not found; set LIBREOFFICE_PROGRAM to its program directory.
cli_out: output file (default: save over the deck)
cli_update: update every linked chart of a presentation
